Hi Laila — thanks for the clear list. Summary answers below; I’ve also attached the SOC 2 report (redacted) and a draft SLA. If you prefer, Rishi and Neha are available for a quick 30-min sync with your security/legal this week.

1) SOC 2: our 2025 Type II report covers our control environment for the Redwood hosted control plane. Auditor: ClearHarbor LLP. Cover letter is included in the attached PDF (SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf). For Private/VPC deployments we include the same control matrix but we can provide scoping notes — happy to add a short cover letter stating scope for your deployment model.

2) GDPR/HIPAA: we have documented Applicability statements for major regulatory regimes. In short: 
- Encryption: data in transit TLS 1.2+, at-rest encryption with customer-managed KMS for Private deployments; hosted uses provider-managed KMS by default.
- Access controls: RBAC, SSO options (SAML/OIDC), service accounts, and audit logs for admin actions.
- HIPAA: Redwood offers a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for customers with PHI; Neha can share the applicability statement and our PSQ matrix.

3) Data deletion / retention SLAs (high-level summary — please see attached draft Data-Retention-SLA-Draft.docx for formal language):
- Primary customer data (active datastore): Redwood will process customer-initiated deletion requests and remove data from live storage within 7 business days of validated request.
- Application logs / telemetry: default retention 90 days; deletion requests for customer-specific logs will be honored and completed within 30 days (note: aggregated telemetry used for platform metrics is retained in an anonymized form).
- Backups: Redwood performs periodic encrypted backups. Backup retention windows are configurable per-customer; default backup retention is 90 days. Deletion of backups is subject to backup retention windows and may take up to the next backup cycle plus a processing window (up to 30 days) to fully purge across backup replicas. Practically, for customers requiring short backup retention we recommend a custom retention policy (we can support 0–30 day backup retention for Private deployments with appropriate operational change controls).

If Amaya needs guaranteed removal from backups within X days, we can include that in the SLA language and in the procurement terms; it may affect pricing for Dedicated/Private options depending on operational requirements.

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf, Data-Retention-SLA-Draft.docx, Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Amaya.pdf

Let me know if you want the ATO/controls call — we can put Neha on to run through HIPAA controls in detail.

Best,
Marissa
